checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan remote patrol sweeps: every 6 ticks each remote escort hunts pirates for scaled bounty credits, XP and return-fire damage, surfaced in the fleet report, card and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Remote escorts reduced piracy but earned no XP or income, so deployment away from the flagship was a pure sacrifice and the new rank system only rewarded local battles.
impact_assessment.benefits: Stationing a hull on patrol becomes a slower but real progression and income path, and fleet deployment gains a risk/reward choice.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: patrol results must stay deterministic and existing saves must not need new fields; dependency: fleet.py now reads pirate risk and the tick consumes patrol credits; concurrency: the tick mutates fleet hulls, XP, credits, stats and the flight log together; state: unattended patrols can be damaged or destroyed, and the 6-tick cadence must not double-run.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add pure sweep, contact, XP and tick-integration regressions first; cap XP at Ace; use seed + ship id + tick for determinism; verify the cockpit label and a live sweep.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Deterministic 6-tick patrol sweeps with pirate-risk contact chance, scaled bounties, 1/3 XP, return-fire damage, patrol credits in tick payload/stats, fleet-report cadence, cockpit label and CLI footer implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-096 recorded; live Edge showed PATROL 6T and a sweep paying 77 cr/+3 XP/-2 hull; 844 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'patrol-sweeps' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan faction trade pacts: a standing-40 agreement that improves buy and sell prices, persists per faction, is refused at war, and is surfaced in the Empire tab and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Standing 40 had no distinct reward between gifts and the standing-70 alliance, and war had no economic cost beyond severed trade links.
impact_assessment.benefits: Diplomacy gains a mid-tier commercial goal, trade routes gain a durable benefit, and war now suspends a valuable agreement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: trade_pacts must default empty for legacy saves and every player-facing quote must use the same pact flag; dependency: the quote signature changes and six callers must pass the flag; concurrency: diplomacy mutates standings, pacts and the flight log in one locked transaction; state: pacts persist and must be suspended, not deleted, during war.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add quote, standing-gate, war-suspension, persistence and UI/CLI regressions first; default the quote parameter false; verify the live Empire PACT click and market prices.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted trade_pacts, standing-40/war gates, 6% quote improvement across local trade, automation, quantum freight, depot sales and snapshots, Empire PACT control, CLI action/status and market header implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-097 recorded; live Edge formed a Sol Coalition pact and moved titanium 208/164 to 195/173 buy/sell; 852 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'trade-pacts' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan outpost crew assignments: station up to three specialists per outpost for role-weighted output, exclude them from ship bonuses and away teams, and expose assign/recall in the Empire tab and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Outposts produced on their own while crew only affected the flagship, so there was no way to invest a specialist in an installation.
impact_assessment.benefits: Crew allocation becomes a real choice between ship bonuses and outpost output, and the Empire tab gains a direct management control.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: assigned_crew must default empty for legacy saves and production must share one multiplier across tick, cash flow and reports; dependency: outposts.py now reads crew roles and engine guards away/dismiss paths; concurrency: assignment mutates the outpost roster and flight log under the engine lock; state: stationed crew must persist and be excluded from ship bonuses until recalled.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add multiplier, assignment, persistence and API/CLI/UI regressions first; cap three crew and x1.60 output; verify the live Empire assign and recall controls.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted Outpost.assigned_crew, three-slot cap, role-weighted x1.60 output bonus, ship-bonus/away/dismiss guards, /api/outpost/crew, outpost crew|recall CLI, Empire assign/recall controls and crew OUTPOST badge implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-098 recorded; live Edge stationed Imani Vale for x1.20 output and recalled her; 861 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'outpost-crew' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan monthly fleet upkeep: role-based cost for living escorts, separate crew/fleet cash-flow lines, month-end charge, and a damaged-readiness penalty when unpaid.

impact_assessment.why: Escorts had purchase, repair and training costs but no recurring upkeep, while patrol sweeps and outpost crew now generate steady income, so a large fleet was nearly free to hold.
impact_assessment.benefits: Fleet size gains a real monthly cost, patrol income becomes partly self-funding, and unpaid upkeep is a recoverable readiness penalty rather than permanent loss.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: cash flow must keep crew and fleet totals separate and legacy callers must still read upkeep_per_month; dependency: month-end credits and readiness now depend on fleet composition; concurrency: the tick charges credits and rewrites fleet statuses together; state: destroyed hulls must not cost upkeep and shortfall status must be repairable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add pure upkeep, cash-flow, month-charge and shortfall regressions first; exclude destroyed hulls; verify the fleet header and crew cash-flow lines in live Edge.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Role-based fleet upkeep, separate crew/fleet cash-flow fields, month-end charge with shortfall readiness penalty, fleet-header line, crew cash-flow line, report/CLI upkeep and tick payload fields implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-099 recorded; live Edge showed 1 escort at 30 cr/month and a 65+30=95 cr/month cash flow; 868 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'fleet-upkeep' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan escort squadron roles: persisted screen/strike/support orders with distinct damage, evasion and support-repair effects, a clickable role badge, API and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Every local escort used the same damage and screen formula, so individual hull orders had no tactical identity beyond the global formation stance.
impact_assessment.benefits: Fleet composition gains a second tactical axis, support hulls trade damage for endurance, and screen corvettes become harder to hit but hit softer.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: legacy saves must default to screen and every fleet damage/evasion path must read the role; dependency: support repair runs inside the combat exchange; concurrency: role changes mutate the fleet roster and flight log under the engine lock; state: roles persist and must be locked under fire.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add role math, support repair, persistence, API/CLI and UI regressions first; normalize invalid roles; verify the badge cycle in live Edge.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted tactical_role with screen/strike/support multipliers, default roles by hull, support repair after incoming fire, role report fields, combat lock, /api/fleet/escort/role, fleet role CLI and clickable badge implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-100 recorded; live Edge cycled a corvette from Screen to Strike with no console errors; 878 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'fleet-roles' completed successfully.
